title: DbDataBuild folder file
description: A folder's _dbdatabuild.yml under models/: the same `defaults:` section of model settings as the project file, layered between the project file and the models beneath the folder (the nearest wins). It has no other section; the project-wide sections (connections, tracking, policy, string semantics) are root-only. This schema is for editors; the tool applies the same rules where the settings are merged into a model.
